items.raw_excerpt: ProRail has announced there will be no trains to or from Amsterdam central station on Saturday, October 3 due to maintenance works. The time table on Sunday, October 5 and Monday, October 6 will also significantly altered, the national rail operator said. The work is part of ongoing renovations at the capital’s main train station. Currently it services around 200,000 travelers per day, one of the busiest in the country. That number is expected to grow to 275,000 per day....
items.summary_en: ProRail says there will be no trains to or from Amsterdam Central Station on Saturday, October 3. The work is part of a big renovation at the busiest station in the country. Trains on Sunday, October 5, and Monday, October 6, will also run very different timetables.
